haikus.haiku:
Crunchy shells soft glow
Nutty scent swirls bright in air
Tasting joy with friends
Happy #NationalNutDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Soft snow whispers light
Each breath a soft gentle song
Joy blooms in soft pause
Happy #InternationalStutteringAwarenessDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Keys dance in moonlight
Melody swells like warm breeze
Birthday sighs in keys
#HappyBirthdayFranzLiszt from @ClamBakeSanta
